meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理生物序列、解析文件、访问NCBI数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理FASTA/GenBank文件或需要批量查询NCBI。
copy.tagline_en: Manipulate biological sequences, parse files, and access NCBI databases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with FASTA/GenBank files or need batch NCBI queries.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能处理生物序列（DNA/RNA/蛋白质），读写 FASTA、GenBank 等文件，访问 NCBI 数据库，运行 BLAST 搜索，进行序列比对、系统发育分析和蛋白质结构分析。
howto.when: 当你要求处理生物信息学任务，如序列操作、文件格式转换、数据库查询或 BLAST 搜索时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 GenBank 下载序列 EU490707。
say.note: Claude 会用 Entrez 获取序列并显示信息。

say.text: 读取这个 FASTA 文件，计算每条序列的 GC 含量。
say.note: Claude 会解析文件并输出统计结果。

say.text: 用 BLAST 搜索这段 DNA 序列，返回前 5 个匹配。
say.note: Claude 会运行在线 BLAST 并列出头部结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can handle biological sequences (DNA/RNA/protein), read/write FASTA, GenBank, etc., access NCBI databases, run BLAST searches, perform sequence alignment, phylogenetics, and protein structure analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for bioinformatics tasks such as sequence manipulation, file format conversion, database queries, or BLAST searches.

say_en.note: Claude will use Entrez to fetch and display the sequence.

say_en.text: Read this FASTA file and compute GC content for each sequence.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the file and output statistics.

say_en.text: BLAST this DNA sequence and return top 5 hits.
say_en.note: Claude will run online BLAST and list top results.
